title: Catalog controls
responsibility: Filters a catalog by search, changes, verification and shared usage.

inputs.name: ExplorerControls.noun
inputs.description: Required lowercase plural entity name used in search labels and placeholder.

inputs.name: ExplorerControls.filter
inputs.description: Bindable query, changed-only, verification, shared usage and ordering choices.

inputs.name: ExplorerControls.groups
inputs.type: Array<{ id: string; title: string; count: number }> | undefined
inputs.description: Optional category counts for the existing unit filters.

inputs.name: ExplorerControls.customFilters
inputs.description: Optional collection-specific fields rendered in the shared filter modal.

inputs.name: ExplorerControls.activeFilters
inputs.description: Number of active collection-specific filter choices.

outputs.name: ExplorerControls
outputs.description: Local search and one filter icon above the catalog. The shared modal holds filters and ordering.
